I'm an Assistant Professor at the Computer Science Department of the Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais (UFMG), working on the intersections between Artificial Intelligence and Creativity, specifically in Generative AI for Music and Games. Previously, I was an Assistant Professor of Computer Science at the Universidade Federal de Viçosa (UFV). I was also a Postdoctoral Fellow at the University of Alberta as part of the Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute (Amii). I received a Ph.D. in Computer Science from the University of California, Santa Cruz, a M.Sc. in Computer Science from the Universidade de São Paulo, and a B.Sc. in Computer Science from Universidade Federal do Paraná.

December 2024

I joined Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais as an Assistant Professor at the Computer Science Department.

December 2024

Felipe Marra (my M.Sc. student) and I presented our paper Long-Form Text-To-Music Generation With Adaptive Prompts: A Case Study In Tabletop Role-Playing Games Soundtracks at the 1st LAMIR (Latin American Music Information Retrieval) workshop!

August 2024

This semester (2024/2) I will be teaching INF721 - Deep Learning
